name: keymaster

scripts.build: pnpm test:types && npm run build -w @keymaster/web && node scripts/check-web-production-artifacts.mjs
scripts.verify:lifecycle-release: pnpm verify:final-io-audit && pnpm verify:lifecycle-deployment && pnpm test:e2e:external && pnpm test:e2e:irreversible-io && pnpm test:e2e:recovery && pnpm verify:lifecycle-production-gates
scripts.test:types: pnpm typecheck && pnpm check:contracts && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm lint:worker-boundaries
scripts.lint:boundaries: node scripts/check-storage-hard-switch.mjs && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && pnpm lint:worker-boundaries && node scripts/check-coordinator-final-io-audit.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm lint:react-boundaries && pnpm lint:worker-boundaries && node scripts/run-vitest-batches.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:local-core: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=local-core
scripts.test:e2e:dev-http: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.dev-http.config.ts --project=dev-http
scripts.test:e2e:dev-local: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.dev-local.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:initial-setup-smoke: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.integration.config.ts e2e/integration/journeys/local/initialization-generated.spec.ts --project=local-integration
scripts.test:e2e:multi-tab-refresh-smoke: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.integration.config.ts e2e/integration/journeys/local/multi-tab-recovery.spec.ts --project=local-integration
scripts.test:e2e:integration: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.integration.config.ts --project=local-integration
scripts.test:e2e:msfile: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.msfile.config.ts --project=msfile
scripts.test:e2e:satsubscription: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && node scripts/run-satsubscription-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:resources: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.resources.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:s3: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.s3.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:deployment: pnpm check:integration-coverage && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.deployment.config.ts --project=deployment-acceptance

description: 本地优先的 BSV 浏览器钱包。基于插件架构，按"基础设施 / 平台 / 业务"三层分离。
